newsitem.title: BELGIUM: GOD TO DAVIGNON - I'M ON WWW.CATHO.BE.
newsitem.headline: GOD TO DAVIGNON - I'M ON WWW.CATHO.BE.

text.p: A leading Belgian industrialist who earlier this week looked for God and the Holy Spirit on the Internet has had his prayers answered: the Belgian Catholic church has opened its own website at WWW.CATHO.BE.

Etienne Davignon, the ever-witty chairman of major Belgian holding company Societe Generale de Belgique, said on Wednesday he had no knowledge of a possible merger between the French company controlling SGB and another French firm.

But he had looked for confirmation elsewhere. "(A merger) is something maybe God and the Holy Spirit are aware of, but I have been trying to contact them on the Internet and I have not had many answers at the moment," he told a company news conference.
Belgian bishops said in a statement on Thursday they wanted a presence in cyberspace to allow christians to use the new-age means of communcation.

"The creation of this website reflects the will for a link between a developing culture and a heritage common to christians...in a society where communication is becoming more and more impersonal," they said.
